title: Agent OS Extensions
description: Extension configuration shape. Used as the whole of ~/.agent-os/defaults.json (user level) and as the `extensions` field of .agent-os/config.json (project level, which references this schema). Within each tier, project entries are applied after user entries, so they win on conflict.

mode.description: Controls only the plugin defaults (tech-adaptation for architect, backend-developer and frontend-developer). extend = add the plugin defaults. replace = do not add them. Context, stage, role and agent entries are always kept in both modes.

skillList.description: Skill names to inject. Each name is looked up in the project .claude/skills/ (the role's subrepo first in monorepo/multi-repo), then ~/.claude/skills/, then the plugin.

items.description: Skill name (e.g. 'my-team-guide') or a skill from an installed plugin as '<plugin>:<skill>', using the plugin's manifest name (e.g. 'agent-os:tech-adaptation', 'the-antislop:antislop').

docList.description: Doc files the agent reads before starting.

items.description: Absolute path, ~/path, or path relative to the workspace root.

agentList.description: Extra agent names to run in parallel with the qa-engineer. Their findings are merged into the QA report.

items.description: Agent name as it appears in .claude/agents/ or ~/.claude/agents/.

commandEntry.description: A post-QA command. A plain name always requires an approval gate. Use the object form with auto = true only for commands that are safe to run without approval.

oneOf.description: Command name as it appears in .claude/commands/ or ~/.claude/commands/. Always gated.
Command with an explicit execution policy.

name.description: Command name as it appears in .claude/commands/ or ~/.claude/commands/.

auto.description: true = run after QA without an approval gate. false (default) = present an approval gate first.

commandList.description: Commands to run after QA passes. Every command requires an approval gate unless configured with auto = true.

scaffoldIfNew.description: Skill name to run as a project scaffold before the first subtask. Applied only when config.project_type is 'new'.

stageExtension.description: Skills and docs for every agent in a stage without per-role config (discovery, planning).

roleExtension.description: Per-role skills and docs for the design stage.

developmentRoleExtension.description: Per-role skills and docs for Stage 4 (Development), plus an optional scaffold skill.

agentExtension.description: Per-agent skills and docs, applied after stage and role entries. Agent mode wins over role mode.

qaAgentExtension.description: Per-agent config for the qa-engineer: skills, docs, extra agents and post-QA commands.

agents.description: Per-agent skill and doc overrides, applied after stage and role entries; agent mode wins. Keys must be plugin agent names.

design.description: Extensions for Stage 3: Design & Architecture. Role sections are resolved separately for each role active in config.focus.

development.description: Extensions for Stage 4: Development. Configured per role only.
